author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
Produced by Chris Boebel and Brett Paci, and edited by David Ozug, this fifteen-minute documentary celebrates MIT OpenCourseWare’s origin, influence, and global reach.

This documentary is the second of MIT Open Learning's MIT Stories documentary series. View the first MIT Story documentary, "Full Circle: Paula Hammond at MIT" here: https://video.odl.mit.edu/videos/5444a783abb94d1fb773ff390d21a603/?utm_source=mit-learn&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=mit-stories-paula-hammond

Please note that the content of these documentaries is not covered under OCW's Creative Commons license.
title: Documentary: “The Courage to Be Open: MIT OpenCourseWare and the Democratization of Knowledge”
